subtitle: Year 8 History Revision
description: Agorian. Year 8 Humanities revision for Medieval Europe and Shogunate Japan. Challenge what you know.
ogDescription: Year 8 History revision for Medieval Europe and Shogunate Japan. Quick questions with explanations, timed challenges, a timeline game, flashcards and paragraph practice.

units.name: Medieval Europe
units.blurb: Feudalism, castles, the Church, the Crusades and the Black Death.

units.name: Shogunate Japan
units.blurb: Samurai, the Tokugawa, sakoku and the Meiji Restoration.

hero.text: The agora was the open square of Athens where citizens traded, voted and were questioned by Socrates. This is yours. Quick questions with an explanation after every answer, timed challenges, a timeline game, flashcards for the key terms and exam-style paragraph prompts, all across Medieval Europe and Shogunate Japan.
hero.alt: Raphael's fresco The School of Athens, philosophers in debate under a great arch
hero.cap: Raphael, The School of Athens, 1511. Athenian thinkers arguing in a great hall. Socrates is at the left in the olive robe, counting off his points on his fingers.

welcome.lead: An additional revision tool. Finish the revision booklet first, then test yourself here.
steps: Three times, write one Short answer practice question and mark it honestly against the model response.
Twice, do one Source analysis practice and one Paragraph practice, timed.
Once, try Challenge, then Key terms for anything you blanked on.

breakdown.title: Exam breakdown
items: 50 marks in 50 minutes, plus 5 minutes reading time.
Section A: multiple choice, 10 marks. About a minute a question.
Section B: short answers, 32 marks. Identify, describe, explain and compare questions, some using a source. About 45 seconds a mark.
Section C: extended response, 8 marks. Choose one of two questions and use a TEEAL structure with a clear contention. About 15 minutes.
Blue or black pen. Sources are in a separate booklet. Attempt every question.

modes.title: Multiple-choice practice
modes.blurb: Pick topics, answer at your pace, read the explanation after every question.

modes.title: Short answer practice
modes.blurb: Section B questions. Write yours and then check with a model response.

modes.title: Paragraph practice
modes.blurb: Six Section C practice prompts with a TEEAL scaffold and a timer.

modes.title: Source analysis practice
modes.blurb: Ten sources you have not seen. Four quick questions each, then a timed 3-mark answer.

modes.title: Challenge
modes.blurb: 20 questions from both units against a 10 minute clock.

modes.title: Timeline
modes.blurb: Both units side by side, 800 to 1900. Starred years are the ones to learn; tap an event for detail.

modes.title: Key terms
modes.blurb: Flashcards to flip, plus a ten-definition sprint against the clock.

modes.title: Fun facts
modes.blurb: Did-you-know cards from both units. Read one, then practise the topic it came from.

verdicts: Exam ready on these topics. Try the paragraph prompts next.
Solid. Read the explanations on the ones you missed and go again.
Getting there. Practise the weak topics below before the next challenge.
Early days. Pick one topic at a time in Practice and build it up.
